title: Cut over to one extension after acceptance
description: After all P1 gates pass, disable/remove the prior runtime registration, verify only pi-search owns the public tools, update install and docs, and record rollback only as source history rather than a second active extension.

logs.msg: Cutover executed: removed npm:pi-web-access from active Pi package list; pi-search remains installed from Git and registers exactly web_search/web_fetch/web_research.
